failures.resolution: Cached facet evidence was never loaded for final log actions. Added a cache-only log policy pass that marks rather than refuses, persists the blocked verdict and flagged name, and appends an off-plan notice; unavailable evidence remains unverified.

Coach grounding searched only catalog rows, so the exact role-less custom food was dropped before C4 role advice. Added an exact account-scoped user-food fallback and a read-only Jev role-advice pass for grounded Eats/Avoid additions; the synthetic food now has unambiguous protein-anchor macros.

The commit path recomputed policy from allergen and Avoid evidence only, so it erased the cached soy mark even after action grounding was fixed. It now merges cache-only preference facets at commit with facetAction mark and keeps the existing write-through behavior.

The fast action path returned immediately after basic grounding and bypassed the post-grounding role-advice pipeline. Both fast and LLM action paths now share the same log-mark, role-advice, and recipe-policy application before persistence.
